provided: Real-world pay by specialty and experience stage: electrical vs. civil/mechanical vs. software engineer, at fresh-grad, 2-3yr, and 5-7yr stages — the main source for the market ranges in this file.

source: worldsalaries.com — Electrical Engineer & Computer Engineer, Jordan
provided: Used in an earlier draft of this file, then dropped: its 'Electrical Engineer, Master's degree' figure (JOD 23,140/yr) is identical to an unrelated 'AI Developer' figure reported elsewhere, indicating a generic template rather than real per-occupation data. Kept here only for the record.

source: 3arabi.ai — 'AI Salaries in Jordan' (source of the duplicate-figure discovery)

provided: Confirms these industrial employers hire Mechanical, Chemical, and Civil engineers and pay a 16-salary/yr structure (13th–16th month bonuses); used as industrial-sector context for Mechanical and Chemical Engineering.

provided: Real entry-level job posting stating a monthly salary of JOD 500 for a Chemical Engineering graduate; anchors the Chemical Engineering entry-level figure.
